title: Relative algebraic-space Picard sheaf by local line representatives
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ with its small etale module sheaves and line modules [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:X\to S$. Use canonical tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], the actual scheme tests, fibre products $X_T$ and induced fibre maps of [def-sfb-space-proper-quot-functor], and the big fppf topology [def-pc-fppf-site]. Let $Q$ be an algebraic space over $S$ endowed with a natural commutative group law $G$ [def-sfb-smooth-integral-group-space]; no smoothness or integral-fibre property is part of the group-law datum. A relative Picard presentation on $(Q,G)$ consists of maps $c_T$ from actual line modules on $X_T$ to $Q(T)$, constant on module isomorphism classes and natural for the specified tensor pullback. Every section of $Q(T)$ is, on some fppf covering sieve, of the form $c_U(L)$. For two line modules $L,M$ on $X_T$, $c_T(L)=c_T(M)$ if and only if their canonical tensor pullbacks become isomorphic on some fppf covering sieve. Multiplication satisfies $c_T(L\otimes M)=c_T(L)c_T(M)$, the trivial module has class $1$, and any tensor inverse (equivalently the dual line) has the inverse class. Tensor is the sheafified sectionwise tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Its comparison with a small-carrier line module is expressed after the existing fully faithful sectionwise ULift transport to a universe containing the site [def-pur-cochain-coefficient-universe-transport], without imposing a size equality. The commutative regular-functions sheaf used here is the existing one of [def-sfb-space-quasi-coherent-algebra], with exactly the same section rings and restriction maps as the ring-valued structure sheaf. These local representative and local equality conditions identify $Q$ with the fppf sheafification of $T\mapsto\operatorname{Pic}(X_T)$ and fix its group operations.
